What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[This Is MY Ship!]]: left, the image of [[This Is MY Ship! (Errata)]] (holotable commit a57375e); right, the image of [[This Is MY Ship! (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit e41c05e). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/thisismyship.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e41c05ef21a38c1cabc077f18c85f56232f383f3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/thisismyship.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
